name: AWS Cloud MCP Server
shortDescription: Interact with AWS resources: S3 buckets, Lambda functions, CloudWatch logs, ECS tasks, and DynamoDB.
longDescription: Connect AI development assistants to your Amazon Web Services accounts. Inspect S3 bucket objects, invoke and test Lambda functions, query CloudWatch log streams, and inspect DynamoDB table items with IAM credentials.
author: aws-samples

envVars.name: AWS_PROFILE
envVars.description: Configured AWS CLI profile name from ~/.aws/credentials

tools.name: s3_list_objects
tools.description: List keys and prefixes in an S3 bucket.

tools.name: cloudwatch_get_logs
tools.description: Fetch recent log events from a CloudWatch log group.

tools.name: lambda_list_functions
tools.description: List deployed AWS Lambda functions in region.

prerequisites: Configured AWS credentials via `aws configure` or environment variables

installSteps.title: Set Environment Variables
installSteps.description: Set `AWS_REGION` and ensure credentials exist in ~/.aws/credentials or IAM role.
